edit.title: Edit mode
edit.hint: Changes stay in this browser until you download the file. Achievement progress is recalculated from the edited data. Click inventory slots and skills, or use the edit buttons in the Raw data tab.
edit.hintClosed: Editing is paused; your changes are kept until you discard them or load another file.
edit.downloaded: Downloaded. Close Valheim, back up your current character file, then replace it with this one. Steam unlocks an achievement the next time a matching stat goes up in the game (e.g. craft any item).
edit.leaveText: Your edits haven't been downloaded yet. Loading another file discards them.

credit.explain: Each crafted input below should have become one finished item when it was taken out. Crediting raises each finished item's crafted count to match, the way the game records your own take-outs. Counts are only ever raised.

drops.intro: Since game version 1.0.20, rare creature drops (a chance of 30% or less) aren't rolled on every kill. The game counts down kills per item and chance, and the item drops for sure when the counter runs out; the counter then restarts at a random value of up to about twice the average. Stars double a drop's chance, so they have their own counters, while creatures that drop the same item at the same chance share one. In multiplayer, a kill counts for the player whose game controls the creature.

drops.editNote: The game keeps the counters in memory and only adds those of the character it loads, so restart the game before playing an edited character.

details.lenient: Lenient: each category counts up to 115 % of its target, and the capped total must exceed the sum of all targets. Counts are the pieces you built that were loaded around you when you last placed a piece.
details.lenientMet: This one is met through leniency.
details.dynamic: This list is rebuilt from the game data the same way the game builds it.
